Scritchy Scratchy

Download Now

Have you always wanted to quit your day job to go scratch, scratch-off’s all day!? Well now you can!

This is the free demo, the full version can be bought below and on Steam! We hope you enjoy :)


If you have feedback or want to follow the development

Scritchy Scratchy is also available on iOS and Android!

You can buy it on mobile here:

  • iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/scritchyscratchy/id6758328352 
  • Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fundaygames.scritchyscratchy&hl=en 

Mobile and PC versions are identical and priced similarly.
